name: TrueMargin
summary: Shopify app that shows profit per order after cost of goods, using the cost per item already on your products.
best_for: Small Shopify stores that want a margin per order from the cost per item they already keep in Shopify, at no cost for now
skip_if: you need proven track record and reviews before you install, you want fees, shipping and VAT tested on your own store first, or you sell outside Shopify
honest_knock: The app is new: it launched on 18 August 2026 and shows 0 reviews. The App Store page says "free right now", which does not promise a free plan later. The overview screen shows no margin percentage, only the Orders and Reports screens do, and until cost rules are set up other costs read US$0.00.

pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-20 on apps.shopify.com/truemargin-eu) TrueMargin by Fleeta Limited is listed as Free on the Shopify App Store, with the text "free right now". The page shows no paid plans. On 20 November 2026 Shopify showed "No plan selected" under Billing for the app on our test store and asked for no charge approval. We have not paid anything.

compare_with.name: Shopify admin cost per item
compare_with.why: Shopify itself shows profit and margin on a product page once you fill in the cost per item, as we saw in our test. TrueMargin adds the per order view and the roll-ups by product, period and market on top of that same field.

sessions.what: Our AI assistant ran the test on 20 November 2026 on a Shopify development store with the Basic plan and two test orders. We installed the app from its Shopify App Store page, filled in a cost per item on the two ordered products and looked at the Orders and Reports screens. About 3 minutes 20 seconds passed between pressing Install and the first margin figure. The app asked for no plan and no card, and we paid nothing. We removed the app afterwards.
findings: Install: the Shopify dialog asked for read access to products, orders, customer data and store owner data. There was no plan screen and no approval step. The app opened on a "Profitability overview" after about 10 seconds.
Before costs: the overview showed 2 orders and US$1,449.90 in sales, with "COGS COVERAGE 0/2" and both orders marked "INCOMPLETE" because the cost was unknown.

Cost per item: the app reads the cost from the "Cost per item" field of the Shopify variant, not from its own form. After we entered US$310 and US$395 in Shopify and reloaded the app, coverage read 2/2 and both orders were "COMPLETE".
Margin: the Orders screen showed 55.7% and 47.3% per order, with known contribution of US$744.90. The Reports screen showed a margin of 51.4%. The overview screen itself shows no margin percentage.
Plan: Shopify showed "No plan selected" under Billing for the app and the App Store page says Free. Payment fees, VAT and shipping showed US$0.00 and "Cost rules 0" until cost rules are set up.
not_tested: Not tested: cost rules for payment fees, shipping, ads and returns and their effect on margin, the price calculator, the diagnostics screen, Export CSV, comparing periods and markets, and more than two orders.
Not tested: whether payment fees and VAT are deducted per order as the App Store page says, because we set up no cost rules and the screens showed US$0.00 for other costs.
sessions.note: Findings as written up after the session; no pass/fail per task was scored.
